نتراءى (form VI)
# نَتَرَاءَى (natarāʔā) /na.ta.raː.ʔaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# نُتَرَاءَى (nutarāʔā) /nu.ta.raː.ʔaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
